title: Reading list with status, progress and ratings
when: The user wants to keep a list of books to read, reading and finished, with page progress, ratings and a yearly goal.
prompt:
Goal: A personal book log where status, progress and the yearly goal stay consistent with each other.
Steps:
1. Book { id, title, author, status: want | reading | finished, pages, pagesRead, rating, finishedAt, notes }.
2. logic.mjs: addBook (title required, rejects same normalized title and author), setProgress clamping to 0..pages and finishing at 100 percent, statsByYear, sortBooks(key).
3. Segmented buttons Want to read, Reading, Finished with counts; search by title or author.
4. Book card: title, author, progress element with "120 of 300 pages", status select, rating as 5 labeled radios ("3 stars").
5. Goal bar "14 of 20 books in 2026".
6. Persist in localStorage books.v1 guarded; export and import JSON.
7. test.mjs: duplicates, clamp and auto finish, year stats.
Quality bar:
- Finished books always have a date.
- Ratings work by keyboard.
- Cards reflow to one column on phones.
Pitfalls:
- Progress above total pages.
- Rating stars as unlabeled icons.
- Duplicates from extra spaces or case.
Verify:
- [ ] Form fields labeled.
- [ ] Status and progress agree.
- [ ] Reload keeps everything.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (book rules), test.mjs.

examples.input: a reading list app to track my books this year
examples.output: tabs Want/Reading/Finished, progress bars, star ratings, goal 14 of 20
